requirement.original: Fix 5 sidebar bugs: AskUserQuestion answer disappears on re-entry, Todo color rendering issues, sidebar scroll position resets on push/pop, subagent todo updates not reflected, disable interaction on rendered elements inside sidebar.
requirement.clarified: Fix 5 bugs related to the sidebar feature: (1) persist AskUserQuestion selected answers across component remounts, (2) apply correct color scheme to todo items in both TodoView and SidebarTodoView, (3) preserve scroll position when pushing/popping sidebar navigation, (4) show only latest TodoWrite state in sidebar, (5) disable content-area press handlers on nested ToolViews in sidebar.
requirement.what: Fix 5 sidebar-related bugs in the happy-app React Native application
requirement.why: Sidebar tool views have broken state persistence, wrong colors, lost scroll position, stale data, and confusing interactions

included: TodoView and SidebarTodoView color scheme (completed=green, in_progress=blue, pending=dark gray)
TodoWrite deduplication in sidebar agent conversation
Disable onContentPress on ToolView instances inside sidebar
excluded: Server-side changes to persist AskUserQuestion answers
CLI-side changes to write answers into tool.result

success_criteria: AskUserQuestion shows previously selected answer when re-entering conversation
Todo items render with correct colors: completed=green, in_progress=blue, pending=dark gray, no black
Scroll position preserved on sidebar pop after push
Only latest TodoWrite prominently shown in sidebar agent conversation
Content areas in sidebar ToolViews are not clickable (header remains clickable)
constraints: Must use existing theme color tokens (no new colors)
Must work on both desktop and mobile viewports

bugs.symptom: Selected AskUserQuestion answer disappears when leaving and re-entering conversation
bugs.root_cause: AskUserQuestionView.tsx:271-273 tries to recover answers from tool.result.answers or tool.permission.answers, but neither field is populated after component remount. The answers are sent via sessionAllow() RPC as reason text and answers record, but the app does not persist these on the tool object. Local React state (selections Map) is lost on unmount.
bugs.why_introduced: AskUserQuestion was implemented with local state only; answer persistence was not considered for re-mount scenario
bugs.why_problematic: Users lose visual confirmation of their selection when navigating away and back
bugs.fix_direction: Parse the reason text (format 'Header: Label\nHeader2: Label2') from tool.permission.reason to recover answers. Or check if permission object retains the reason/answers fields after resolution.

bugs.symptom: Todo items have wrong colors: in_progress shows gray (warning=#8E8E93) instead of blue, pending text may be black, sidebar completed text is gray not green
bugs.root_cause: Both TodoView.tsx and SidebarTodoView.tsx reference theme.colors.typography which DOES NOT EXIST in theme.ts (only theme.colors.text exists). This resolves to undefined, causing fallback to black/default. Additionally: (1) inProgressText uses theme.colors.warning (#8E8E93 = gray) not blue, (2) SidebarTodoView only applies completedText style (gray+strikethrough), missing inProgressText and pendingText conditional styles, (3) SidebarTodoView completedText uses textSecondary (gray) not success (green).
bugs.root_cause_commit: N/A - original implementation used wrong theme keys
bugs.why_introduced: theme.colors.typography was likely renamed to theme.colors.text at some point, or was never a valid key
bugs.why_problematic: Colors don't match user expectation: completed should be green, in_progress should be blue, pending should be dark gray body text color
bugs.fix_direction: Replace theme.colors.typography with theme.colors.text. Change inProgressText and iconInProgress from warning to radio.active (blue). In SidebarTodoView: add inProgressText and pendingText conditional style application, change completedText to use success color. Ensure icon colors match text colors.

bugs.symptom: Sidebar scroll position resets to top when popping back from a pushed sub-tool view
bugs.root_cause: rightSidebarStore.ts SidebarData interface has no scrollY field. When push() is called (line 28-31), current data is saved to history but scroll position is not captured. SidebarAgentConversation.tsx uses a plain ScrollView with no scroll position tracking or restoration.
bugs.why_introduced: Scroll preservation was not part of original sidebar push/pop design
bugs.why_problematic: Users lose their place in long agent conversations when drilling into sub-tools
bugs.fix_direction: Add scrollY to SidebarData. Track scroll position via onScroll handler on ScrollView. On push, save current scrollY to the history entry. On pop, restore scrollY via scrollTo() in useEffect.

bugs.symptom: Sidebar shows all intermediate TodoWrite snapshots instead of highlighting the latest state
bugs.root_cause: Each tool-call message for TodoWrite is rendered independently in SidebarAgentConversation. This is technically correct (each call IS distinct), but the UX expectation is to see only the latest todo state prominently.
bugs.why_introduced: Sidebar renders all child messages linearly without special handling for superseded tool calls
bugs.why_problematic: Users see outdated todo lists alongside the current one, causing confusion
bugs.fix_direction: Before rendering messages, identify consecutive TodoWrite calls and only render the last one expanded. Earlier TodoWrite calls can be collapsed or hidden. Filter in ChildMessageBlock or in the messages array before mapping.

bugs.symptom: Tapping content areas (Edit diffs, Todo lists) inside sidebar triggers push navigation to a new sidebar level showing the same content
bugs.root_cause: SidebarAgentConversation.tsx:30-31 ChildToolBlock passes onContentPress to ToolView. ToolView.tsx:99-109 wraps specialized content in TouchableOpacity when onContentPress is provided. This makes ALL content areas clickable, even for tools where drilling into content makes no sense.
bugs.root_cause_commit: N/A - onContentPress was designed for main chat navigation, not sidebar
bugs.why_introduced: ChildToolBlock copied the main chat pattern of passing onContentPress without considering that sidebar already provides push navigation via header
bugs.why_problematic: Users accidentally trigger confusing navigation when tapping content in the sidebar
bugs.fix_direction: Remove onContentPress from ChildToolBlock in SidebarAgentConversation.tsx. Keep onPress for header navigation. Content areas will render without TouchableOpacity wrapper.

context.codebase_state: main branch with staged changes in sidebar-related files

development_approach.strategy: Fix each bug independently in order of priority. Bug 2 (colors) and Bug 5 (interaction) are simplest. Bug 1 (answer persistence) requires investigating how permission.reason is persisted. Bug 3 (scroll) requires adding state to the store. Bug 4 (todo dedup) requires message filtering logic.
development_approach.validation_approach: Deploy to happy-web-dev, use Playwright to navigate to dev.life-ai.app, verify each bug fix by rendering real content in both desktop and mobile viewports

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI bug fixes with clear root causes identified from code analysis
